model.summary: Model favors NYJ by 2.6 points (59% win chance). Biggest factors: Rest days (home minus away) (MIA +1.4), Offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (NYJ +0.9), Rushing offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (MIA +0.8). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 42.5 total points (NYJ 23, MIA 20). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 2.2), Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 2.1), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 1.9). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
